name: 30038 · Lithonia, GA
findings: ZIP 30038 (Lithonia) has 231 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30038 (Lithonia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
